current_source_findings.finding: Explicit predict_node_ids supports NF/Yam dual query/reference eligibility; references-file dates are cast to integer at line 144.
The checked native reference loop evaluates every ref_node_id; there is no focal-node or diploid-identity filter in that loop. Dropping the closest reference does not enforce identity exclusion.
Four output labels are configurable; nonzero ancestor nodes are rejected.
Feature extraction can use a supplied sample-category map, but donor eligibility needs the explicit common per-focal policy.

decision: Missing paper-era architecture, exact real identities/dates, original seeds and plus/minus definition prevent exact table-number reproduction; they do not prevent a new explicitly specified paired simulation comparison.

Use the published cohort counts with a new synthetic roster and date schedule, one shared observed/error/Relate bank and one shared target manifest. Label the comparison as prospective and current-release, not as reproduction of April Tables 1/2.

The smallest IID phase retaining the published training budget and IID replicate count uses 5 TRAIN + 1 VAL + 3 IID independent parents (900000 total target examples). Add 5 misspecified parents only after their exact prospective parameter sets are frozen.
fairness_critical_shared_artifacts: Synthetic diploid/haplotype roster, integer generation ages, population mapping, role eligibility and focal-diploid exclusion.
Exactly one realized mutation/genotype-error bank per parent, with common variant filtering and phase convention.
Exactly one Relate tree bank per parent, with common map coordinates, ages, sample mapping, version/options/seeds.
Independent parent-level TRAIN/VAL/IID/OOD split and the exact same sampled (parent, inferred_tree, query_haplotype, coordinate) target rows.
Four-founder target ontology and external truth labels joined only for training supervision/validation/scoring; never use truth to construct observed representations or choose donors/support.
Identical reported test rows and per-cohort denominators; method-specific representations and observed sequence context are allowed and disclosed.

native_methods.architecture: Released transformer + bidirectional GRU, 15 nearest references + query, zero ancestor nodes, released log2 TMRCA cap 14; four-founder output supported by model.num_classes/class_labels.
changes_required: Count/roster-generic sample mapping and explicit NF/Yam query IDs while retaining their reference metadata.
Per-focal donor exclusion for both haplotypes of the focal diploid in every enabled sampler backend.
Consume shared coordinate/target manifest with loss mask; preserve released sequence context from observed trees.
Pin finite native fit configuration and dependency/source closure before execution.

native_methods.architecture: Released Keras 5x9 ancestor features -> Flatten -> Dense(512, ReLU) -> Dropout(0.2) -> Dense(6, softmax).
changes_required: Replace hardcoded cohort ranges/replicate IDs with roster and shared target manifest.
Use the same allowed donor identities and per-focal diploid exclusion as every other method; retain native feature channel positions, zero the absent BAA channel.
Preserve six-head architecture and project p1+p5 to Ana, p2+p6 to CHG, p3 to WHG, p4 to EHG; explicitly record this decoder.
Retain five-epoch native training budget; saving/selecting minimum validation loss within these five epochs is an explicit prospective fit adapter.
